user.title: Sign in to Můj ČEZ
user.description:
1. Open **[Můj ČEZ sign-in]({url})** and sign in as usual.
2. You end on a page whose address starts with `https://muj.cez.cz/col/auth-callback?code=…` (the page may stay blank or show an error – that's fine).
3. Copy the **whole address** from the browser's address bar and paste it here.

Your password is never entered into Home Assistant.
